verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Privacy Mode, which keeps code from being used for training and is on by default for Enterprise. It states Cloud Agents store encrypted repo copies only temporarily while the agent runs, references a Zero Data Retention arrangement (which does not apply with BYO keys), and the Cloud Agents API lets users delete agents. However, there is no documented user-facing control over retention periods or deletion of stored data such as chats, prompts or account data. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, documented data/account deletion controls, explicit ZDR enablement docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: With Privacy Mode enabled your code is never used for training by Cursor or other AI model providers.
Privacy Mode is on by default for Enterprise teams.
